title: Contest a transit fine abroad with an agent
summary: A traveler says their AI agent filed a claim over a €140 Paris transit fine and emailed RATP and the Canadian consulate; RATP accepted the refund within three days.
agent_role: The agent filed the claim and sent emails to the transit operator and the consulate; the poster filled out no forms.
outcome: The poster reports RATP accepted the refund of the €140 fine within three days.
what_they_did: The poster was fined €140 on the Paris transit system. They had their AI agent file a claim with RATP, the transit operator. The agent also emailed RATP and the Canadian consulate.
how_it_went: The poster says it took three days, they filled out zero forms, and RATP accepted the refund. A video accompanies the post.
prompt: I was fined [amount] by [transit operator or agency] in [city] on [date] for [reason]. Here are my ticket, receipt and notes: [details]. Find the official way to contest this fine, then draft the claim and any supporting emails, including one to [my consulate] if useful. Show me every draft and the form answers, and wait for my approval before submitting or sending anything.

curation.rationale: A concrete, multi-step dispute handled by an agent with a stated result and a video, though the agent and steps are not detailed. Non-everyday, daily-life use earns a small boost.
